decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the garage hereby approved shall match those used in the construction of the main house.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Domestic Use OnlyThe garage hereby approved shall be used only for the parking of a private car or the storage of domestic effects belonging to the occupier of 116 Great South West Road and for no other purpose including the provision of living accommodation or for any business use.

Condition : 5 - "Before the development hereby permitted commences the applicant must either:
a.	Investigate the site for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the LPA, to ascertain whether gas protection measures are required.  Where measures are required the details shall be submitted to, and approved by, the LPA.
Or;
b.	The applicant shall install gas protection measures as a precautionary measure without first investigating the site.  The details of these measures shall be submitted to, and approved by, the LPA.
c.	For a. and b. all required measures shall be installed before the development is first occupied.
description: Demolition of the existing garage and erection of a single storey detached building comprising a garage and gym
